title: Blog posts are written again: a Groq limit no longer stops the writers
changes: No blog post was written after 18 October: news, blogs and guides all used one Groq model, whose free daily tokens the news used up. Now a model at its limit waits and the next strong model writes, and news starts with the other models so the main one stays for blog posts and guides
If the blog or guide writer still fails, an email goes to the alert address, once a day, with the reason
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/ and unzip it.
To test now: php public_html/api/v1/cron/cli-blog-scheduler.php --write (writes the next blog post for its time)
